item.title: Update to iRAP star rating system announced
item.description: The International Road Assessment Programme (iRAP) has announced that it is updating its current Star Rating model, with version 3.10 coming online from May this year on the organisation's online platform, ViDA.

item.title: National Highways appoints new non-executive director
item.description: National Highways has appointed Vivek Chaudhri as its new non-executive director, replacing Janette Beinart, who has stood down at the end of seven years on the board.

item.title: Top researcher steps down from RAC Foundation
item.description: Research director Elizabeth Box has announced her departure from the RAC Foundation at the end of March after nearly two decades working with the organisation.

item.title: Cycling UK director steps down for mini career break
item.description: The director of external affairs for Cycling UK has announced that she will be stepping down from her role in April of this year.

item.title: Econ crowns Gritter Driver of the Year
item.description: A Durham County Council gritter driver has been crowned the first ever Gritter Driver of the Year, under a new initiative from Econ Engineering designed to boost public recognition of our 'winter heroes'.

item.title: Engagement kicks off on £600m National Highways upgrade scheme
item.description: National Highways has kicked off market engagement on a £600m, decade-long contract for the delivery of the A38 Derby Junctions scheme.

item.title: GeoPura wins £32.6m deal to supply hydrogen for Lower Thames Crossing
item.description: National Highways has named GeoPura, a Nottingham-based hydrogen innovator, as its supplier of green hydrogen for the Lower Thames Crossing project, delivering what is expected to be the largest volume of the fuel ever produced for a British construction project.

item.title: Highways Live: Sustainable and resilient highways workshops
item.description: Highways has launched a new series of events in partnership with the Road Surface Treatments Association (RSTA) to encourage authorities and suppliers to collaborate on building a new future for maintenance strategies.

item.title: Powys appoints 10 companies to 'dynamic purchasing system'
item.description: Powys County Council has appointed 10 suppliers to its dynamic purchasing system for the provision of highways and civil engineering works across the county.

item.title: Morgan Sindall sees record growth as profits pass £5bn
item.description: Morgan Sindall Group saw a record year of growth in 2025, surpassing £5bn in revenue for the first time, as profits grew by 35%.
